subject: EdgeHealth procurement readiness: next steps & timeline
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-11T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: EdgeHealth procurement readiness: next steps & timeline

Hi Sara — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we stay aligned on procurement path and timing.

Key takeaways from our call:
- EdgeHealth is planning a small pilot (1–2 endpoints) to validate latency and cost with Redwood.
- Preferred procurement approach: looks like PO (formal purchase order) is likely, but you may want to charge a pilot to card for speed.
- Internal approvals required: Legal (MSA review), Security (SOC2 evidence + questionnaire), Finance (procurement team/PO issuance).

Attachments sent: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf (draft MPA/terms), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary + link to full report).

Proposed timeline / milestones (please confirm owners & dates):
1) MSA review (Legal) — Redwood sends draft today; EdgeHealth legal review complete by 2027-02-18
2) Security review (Security) — EdgeHealth shares questionnaire by 2027-02-12; Redwood returns SOC2 + answers by 2027-02-14
3) Finance / procurement (PO issuance) — procurement issues PO by 2027-02-25 (target)
4) Prod onramp / pilot start — week of 2027-03-01 (contingent on PO or card payment)

Decision points for you to confirm:
- Confirm PO vs card for pilot (we can accept card to start earlier, PO for production commitment).
- Indicate whether your team is interested in Marketplace procurement (e.g., AWS Marketplace) which adds ~3–4 weeks for listing but simplifies long-term renewal.

Next steps from Redwood: we will (1) upload MSA to DocuSign and share link, (2) send a one-page SOW example for pilot scope, (3) provide a short invoice template for PO processing.

Can you confirm the procurement owner and the preferred payment path so we can finalize the timeline?

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@edgehealth.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: 2027-02-12T09:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EdgeHealth procurement readiness: next steps & timeline

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear recap. Two quick clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Procurement preference: PO for the pilot if we can get an internal exception to expedite. Otherwise we'll use a corporate card for an initial 30-day pilot. I can confirm by end of day 2027-02-13.
- Procurement contact: procurement@edgehealth.ai (please include invoices and cost breakdown on all docs).
- Legal/security request: attached is our vendor questionnaire (edgehealth_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). Please have the SOC2 summary and answers returned to me and our security reviewer (sec-review@edgehealth.ai) by 2027-02-14.

We are also evaluating Marketplace, but that will probably be for later (not for the immediate pilot).

I appreciate the DocuSign flow — please send, and include any billing contacts.

Best,
Sara
Sara Thompson
Head of Partnerships, EdgeHealth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-12T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: EdgeHealth procurement readiness: next steps & timeline

Quick internal note:
- I'll open the HubSpot deal tasks and tag FinanceOps for a pre-bill estimate. HubSpot deal id: DEAL-4738-EDGE (link in related_links).
- Marketplace option: we should flag that AWS Marketplace listing adds lead time; recommend offering card-based pilot now and transition to PO/Marketplace for long-term.
- I'll prepare a one-page SOW and cost table for Rachel to share with procurement.

Karthik

Subject: SOC2 + questionnaire responses

If your security reviewer wants the full report under NDA we can share the signed report; otherwise the summary should cover the standard controls you asked about.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Confirming MAP & PO timing — action items and owners

Thanks everyone — summary of agreed next steps and owners (we'll treat this as the mutual action plan):

Milestone 1 — MSA review (Legal)
- Owner: EdgeHealth Legal (Sara to loop legal)
- Redwood action: DocuSign MSA link shared 2027-02-11 (see related_links)
- Target complete: 2027-02-18

Milestone 2 — Security questionnaire & evidence
- Owner: EdgeHealth Security (sec-review@edgehealth.ai)
- Redwood action: SOC2 summary + completed questionnaire provided 2027-02-14
- Target complete: 2027-02-16

Milestone 3 — Finance / PO issuance
- Owner: EdgeHealth Procurement (procurement@edgehealth.ai)
- EdgeHealth action: Confirm PO vs Card by 2027-02-13 (Sara to confirm) — if PO, target issuance by 2027-02-25
- Redwood action: Provide invoice template and cost breakdown (Karthik)

Milestone 4 — Pilot kickoff
- Owner: Joint (EdgeHealth / Redwood)
- Target: week of 2027-03-01 (contingent on payment path)

Open items for EdgeHealth to confirm: procurement owner email for PO routing (we have procurement@edgehealth.ai), and whether you want to accept card for the pilot to accelerate start.

If PO route is confirmed we will: (1) mark the deal as committed in HubSpot, (2) circulate the invoice template, and (3) queue onboarding. If card route is preferred we can invoice a short pilot immediately and start the environment while legal completes MSA. 

I'll follow up on 2027-02-18 if I haven't heard confirmation. Please reply with any adjustments to owners/dates.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: one-page-pilot-sow.docx
